## Ingredients

- Juice of ½ lemon
- 1 teaspoon dill
- 4 tablespoons olive oil
- 1 teaspoon honey
- 1–2 teaspoons Dijon mustard
- 1 clove garlic, finely minced
- Paprika and ground black pepper, to taste

## Instructions

1. In a small bowl, whisk together lemon juice, dill, olive oil, honey, Dijon mustard, and garlic until smooth.  
2. Season with paprika and black pepper to taste.  
3. Serve immediately or refrigerate for up to 3 days.
